plugin.name: GTA Liberty City Stories PPSSPP Widescreen Fix
MAIN.SkipIntro.description: Skip the opening intro. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting in the hub.
MAIN.ForceAspectRatio.description: Use the emulator aspect ratio automatically, or force a width:height ratio. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting in the hub.
MAIN.Enable60FPS.description: Enable the native 60 FPS patch. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting in the hub.
MAIN.UnthrottleEmuDuringLoading.descript: Unthrottle the emulator during loading. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting in the hub.
CONTROLS.ModernControlScheme.description: Use the alternate modern control scheme. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting in the hub.
CONTROLS.PCCheats.description: Enable the PC cheat input compatibility path. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting in the hub.
HUD.HudScale.description: Scale the heads-up display. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting in the hub.
RADAR.RadarScale.description: Scale the single-player radar. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting in the hub.
RADAR.RadarPosX.description: Adjust the radar horizontal position. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting in the hub.
RADAR.RadarPosY.description: Adjust the radar vertical position; -45 places it at the top. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting in the hub.
MPRADAR.RadarScale.description: Scale the multiplayer radar. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting in the hub.
MPRADAR.RadarPosY.description: Adjust the multiplayer radar vertical position. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting in the hub.
FOV.RestoreCutsceneFOV.description: Cutscenes ignore the field-of-view multiplier and keep their original framing. Aspect correction always applies. Restart after hub changes.
FOV.FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the gameplay field of view on top of the widescreen correction. 1.0 is the original framing; higher is wider. Restart after hub changes.
FOV.CutsceneBorders.description: Black bars that keep cutscenes in their 16:9 cinematic frame: letterbox above and below on narrower screens, pillarbox at the sides on wider screens. Restart after hub changes.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language of the Plugins menu in the game (English only for now). Close and reopen Plugins after changing it.
fovfactor.description: Multiplies the gameplay field of view on top of the widescreen correction. 1.0 is the original framing; higher is wider. Cutscenes are not changed.
hudaspect.description: Keeps the HUD inside a centered box of this aspect ratio (for example 16:9 on an ultrawide screen). Auto uses the whole screen.
